title: Tech Note: Inside the QD Experiment Database

historical_commentary.text: This note is a sequel explaining implementation details of a specific 1997 4D V6 Summer Contest demo database's font and graphics handling, almost certainly built on classic Mac QuickDraw-era graphics APIs and Windows GDI equivalents of the time; both the demo itself and the underlying graphics stack it discusses are long retired, making the note historical-interest-only rather than practically applicable today.
related_updates: Classic QuickDraw graphics (Mac OS) was deprecated by Apple in favor of Quartz/Core Graphics in the Mac OS X era, well after this note was written
The specific QD Experiment demo database and its companion contest (4D V6 Summer Contest 97) no longer exist or are supported
